name: US home service businesses (HVAC, plumbing, roofing, electrical, pest)
icp: Owner-operated US home service companies with roughly 5-60 employees and a real office (not a solo tech), doing residential service and replacement work. Running ads or getting lots of inbound calls.
disqualifiers: Franchise corporate pages or national brands
Solo operators with no office staff
Lead-gen sites, directories or marketing agencies

pains.pain: Missed calls and slow replies to web leads after hours and during busy season
pains.solution: Missed-call text-back plus an AI receptionist that qualifies the job and books it into their FSM (ServiceTitan/Jobber/Housecall Pro)
pains.evidence_to_look_for: No online booking, phone-only CTAs, reviews mentioning not getting a call back, hiring CSRs/dispatchers

pains.solution: Automated, personalized estimate follow-up sequences triggered from the FSM

pains.pain: Few new Google reviews compared with job volume
pains.solution: Post-job review requests and AI-drafted replies to every review
pains.evidence_to_look_for: Low review count relative to years in business, unanswered reviews

offer: A 14-day setup of speed-to-lead (missed-call text-back + booking assistant) connected to their FSM
guarantee: If it doesn't book more jobs in the first 30 days than it costs, they don't pay the monthly fee
mystery_shop: Call after 6pm local time and record what happens (voicemail full? answering service? callback time?)
Submit the website contact/estimate form and time the response
tone: Plain-spoken, short sentences, talks in jobs booked and calls missed, never tech jargon.
